interpretation: These published administrative aggregates are award obligations, not cash outlays, economic benefits or measured policy outcomes. USAspending reporting can be revised and place-of-performance is a reporting attribute. The official response also contains four territories outside the 52-jurisdiction reference layer and one record with blank shape_code. Their exact original amounts are retained in geography-exclusions.json and the original publisher archive, not mapped to any of the 52 states.
method: The USAspending API groups FY2025 award federal-action transaction obligations by primary place of performance. The archived POST request pins all filters, FY action dates 2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30, geography state, spending level transactions. Preserve signed obligation adjustments and full original amount precision as strings. No recipient-location inference, imputation or outlay claim.
